_README: Temporal Overlap Pilot -- roving CONTROL preset. Separate question, separate analysis.
Identical to overlap_pilot.json except absent_class = 'roving'. Here an absent trial is not a
cloud: it carries an organised group at every recurrence, on a fresh set of channels and a
fresh internal order each time. The question becomes whether a frequency set RECURS among
other organised groups, which is not the question the pilot asks.
Two limitations to state whenever it is reported:
* its per-frequency tone inventory does NOT match the present trial's, because the groups
land on different channels. The audit prints the match rate and it is not 1. The fully
matched roving contrast is the asynchrony task (asynchrony_rising_config.json), which uses
matched incidence to put both channel sets in both intervals.
* it must never be pooled with, or substituted for, the plain cells. Analyse it on its own.
